identity.title: Active Galactic Nuclei in Dusty Starbursts at z = 2: Feedback Still to Kick in

paper_type_evidence.quote: We then found archival ALMA continuum counterparts for 33 galaxies (12 SBs-AGN and 21 SBs-SFR). For these sources we computed dust masses

targets.name: 152 Herschel-selected starbursts in COSMOS at 1.5<z<2.5 (33 with ALMA continuum detections)

coordinates.value: per-source RA/Dec listed in the ALMA source table (COSMOS field)

evidence.quote: Out of 1790 *Herschel* detected sources at $1.5<z<2.5$, we identified a sample of 164 SBs

question.value: Do AGN in Herschel-selected dusty starbursts at 1.5<z<2.5 show signs of feedback, e.g. reduced gas fractions or different morphologies, compared with purely star-forming starbursts?

evidence.quote: We study their morphologies, AGN contribution and molecular gas contents (for a sub-sample with an ALMA continuum observation) to infer potential observational evidences of feedback induced by AGN.

bands.value: mostly Band 7 (870 um), a few also Band 3 or 2

evidence.quote: mostly in band 7 at 870$\mu$m (with 4 un-detected sources that we do not include in this work), with few of them detected also in band 3 or 2
We searched for possible ALMA millimetric counterparts of the SBs in the public archive, adopting a search radius of 2.5$"$.

provided.value: far-IR photometry used to select starbursts

evidence.quote: PACS and SPIRE-*Herschel* data are originally from the PEP (cite: 2011A&A...532A..90L) and HerMES (cite: 2012MNRAS.424.1614O) surveys
We performed a visual inspection on the COSMOS/HST ACS $i$-band images of the 140 (out of 152) SBs
We used the CSTACK tool[^3] (v3.1, T. Miyaji) and derive the average Hardness Ratio

what.value: COSMOS2015 photometry, redshifts, stellar masses and Herschel catalog

evidence.quote: Sources identification, multiwavelength photometry, $M_*$ and redshifts are from the COSMOS2015 sample.

what.value: Comparison sample of galaxies with CO measurements

evidence.quote: we use the reference sample compiled by (cite: 2014ApJ...793...19S) and (cite: 2018arXiv180703378P), including ’typical’ star-forming galaxies at $z\leq3$ with measurements of their CO luminosity.

pipeline_or_manual.value: measurement sets calibrated by running the data reduction scripts in CASA

evidence.quote: The measurement sets were calibrated running the data reduction scripts with the Common Astronomy Software Applications (CASA).

what.value: Starburst selection at least a factor 4 above the main sequence

evidence.quote: Starbursts (SBs) are selected to have a SFR well elevated above the MS at $z=2$, at least a factor 4, as in (cite: 2011ApJ...739L..40R).
Dust masses ($M_{dust}$) have been derived following the procedure described in (cite: 2012ApJ...760....6M; 2017A&A...603A..93M)

unstated_but_needed: ALMA project codes and which datasets were used for each source

Criteria for the visual morphological classification

method.value: Herschel-detected COSMOS2015 sources at 1.5<z<2.5 with SFR at least 4x above the main sequence and M*>1e10 Msun

evidence.quote: We limit our analysis to $M_*>10^{10}M_\odot$ (cite: 2016ApJS..224...24L) reducing the SB sample to 152 objects.

method.value: MAGPHYS and SED3FIT fits; AGN preferred if Fisher test at >=99% confidence

evidence.quote: The fit obtained with the AGN is preferred if the reduced $\chi^2$ value of the best fit (at $\ge$99% confidence level, on the basis of a Fisher test)

assumptions.value: SFR from total IR luminosity with Kennicutt (1998) conversion; Chabrier IMF

evidence.quote: assuming a (cite: 1998ARA&A..36..189K) conversion.

validation.value: compared with the IRAC colour-colour diagnostic of Donley et al. (2012), X-ray AGN and mass-weighted ages

evidence.quote: finding that $\sim80\%$ of the SBs-AGN fall into the AGN region, while just one of the SBs-SFR are mis-classified as AGN
Fluxes and associated errors were evaluated with CASA, by fitting the emissions with a bi-dimensional Gaussian
The final sample includes 33 sources with a clear detection over $3\sigma$

analysis_steps.goal: derive dust and gas masses and gas fractions

method.value: fit IRAC-ALMA SED with Draine & Li (2007) models; Mgas = Mdust/GDR

evidence.quote: $M_{gas} = M_{dust}/GDR(Z)$

assumptions.value: GDR ~30 (alpha_CO=0.8); also GDR ~95 for solar metallicity

evidence.quote: we adopt $GDR \approx 30$, that based on (cite: 2012ApJ...760....6M) corresponds to a CO-to-$M_{gas}$ $\alpha_{co}$ conversion factor of 0.8

validation.value: consistent within 0.15 dex with Mgas from R-J monochromatic fluxes (Scoville et al. 2017 recipe)

evidence.quote: consistent (within 0.15dex) with the average $M_{gas}$ estimates derived based on the monochromatic flux densities in the R-J tail of the SED
Fluxes and associated errors were evaluated with CASA
We used both the *MAGPHYS* (cite: 2008MNRAS.388.1595D), and the *SED3FIT*

used_for.value: SED fitting including AGN torus component

evidence.quote: the latter accounting for an additional AGN component (dusty torus).
We used the CSTACK tool[^3] (v3.1, T. Miyaji)
35 out of 152 starbursts (about 23%) show a significant AGN component.
SBs-SFR are disturbed systems (56 out of 68, i.e. $\sim$82$\pm11$% of the HST detected sample)
(13 out of 24 detection, $\sim$55$\pm15$%)

results_numeric.quantity: stacked hardness ratio of compact SBs-AGN

evidence.quote: have compatible $HR=-0.12\pm0.11$, $0.02\pm0.31$, $-0.04\pm0.13$, respectively

findings_qualitative.value: SBs-AGN have no significantly lower gas fraction than SBs-SFR; SBs lie on a continuous sequence of increasing SFE between normal galaxies and ULIRG/SBs

evidence.quote: We then observe that SBs lie on a contiguous sequence of increasing SFE

claims.hypothesis: AGN feedback has already reduced gas fractions in AGN-hosting starbursts
claims.experiment: Compare gas fractions of 12 SBs-AGN and 21 SBs-SFR from ALMA-based dust masses
claims.finding: Feedback has not yet depleted gas in SBs-AGN

evidence.quote: Anyway, feedback effects have not reduced their $f_{gas}$ yet.

claims.hypothesis: SBs-AGN and SBs-SFR have different UV morphologies
claims.experiment: Visual inspection of HST i-band images
claims.result: SBs-SFR mostly disturbed; about half of SBs-AGN compact
claims.finding: SBs-AGN are likely more compact, perhaps final-merger or primordial galaxies

evidence.quote: we interpret our results as a supporting evidence that SBs-AGN are probably more compact and dense sources

limitations_admitted.value: Morphology limited by shallow HST imaging and dust extinction

evidence.quote: We caution that this morphological analysis is limited by the shallowness of the COSMOS/HST imaging

referee_caveats_inferred: Gas masses rest on an assumed GDR and the ALMA fluxes are heterogeneous archival data
Small ALMA subsample, with no CO-based gas measurements
